```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Necessary packages
packages = c("tidyverse", "haven", "here")

# Install then load or load

package.check <- lapply(packages, FUN = function(x) {
  # If not installed, install then load into the environment
  if (!require(x, character.only = TRUE)) {
    install.packages(x, dependencies = TRUE)
    library(x, character.only = TRUE)
  } else {
    # If already installed, load it into the environment
    library(x, character.only = TRUE)
  }
})
```

```{r}
# Load dataset

df <- read_dta(here("data", "clean", "uad_clean.dta"))
head(df)

df %>%
  filter(program == "enterprise") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(non_null_appraisals = sum(!is.na(appraised_value))) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = year, y = non_null_appraisals)) +
    geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(df$year)) +
    labs(
      x = "Year",
      y = "Count of Non-Null Appraisals",
      title = "Count of Non-Null Enterprise Appraisals by Year"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

df %>%
  filter(program == "fha") %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(non_null_appraisals = sum(!is.na(appraised_value))) %>% 
  ggplot(mapping = aes(x = year, y = non_null_appraisals)) +
    geom_col(fill = "darkred") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = unique(df$year)) +
    labs(
      x = "Year",
      y = "Count of Non-Null Appraisals",
      title = "Count of Non-Null FHA Appraisals by Year"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

```
